s = input().strip()
k = int(input())
n = len(s)
if n % k != 0:
    print("NO")
else:
    l = n // k
    valid = True
    for i in range(0, n, l):
        substring = s[i:i+l]
        if substring != substring[::-1]:
            valid = False
            break
    print("YES" if valid else "NO")
